paper.title: Changing climates of conflict / Estimating Average Causal Effects Under General Interference

paper_reference.paper_question: 学校反冲突项目的邀请是否通过朋友网络产生溢出效应？邀请与实际出席如何区分？
paper_reference.target: 本人未获邀时，至少一位朋友获邀减没有朋友获邀，佩戴手环概率之差；全部12人等权。
paper_reference.source_location: Paluck et al. (2016) PNAS, DOI 10.1073/pnas.1514483113; Aronow & Samii (2017) §8 Eq. (16), Corollary 8.1, §10.
paper_reference.formula: tau = (1/12) sum_i [ mu_i(0,S_i=1) - mu_i(0,S_i=0) ], S_i=1 iff at least one friend is invited.
conditions: Two groups of six; each group independently draws exactly two invitations uniformly.
Invitation is the treatment; actual attendance is not substituted.
Design-weighted conditional averaging over remaining invitations.
Positivity for the two friend-invitation states.
what_paper_supports: Design-weighted spillover effects under network interference.
The same school is analyzed; schools are not compared.
what_paper_does_not_support: No claim that invitation equals actual attendance.
No replication of the 56-school field experiment.
No direct import of Table 2 values.

missing_condition.reason: The invitation-list generation law is omitted; the system stops with NETWORK_EFFECT_FACTS_INCOMPLETE.

changed_target.reason: Reverse comparison; expected sign is flipped.

actual_run.provenance: 2026-11-09 local structured run through notification/design/exposure entry with explicit synthetic reviews; api_calls=0.
actual_run.note: All three variants were run locally; no LLM call.

notes: Campus invitation spillover template. Original actual is a saved demo run; variants are reference-only and not run.
